title: 远程会议怎样开得有效
topic: 远程会议怎样开得有效

source.title: How to run effective and engaging remote meetings - Dropbox
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录

paragraphs: Before you reflexively schedule a virtual meeting, make sure it’s for the 3d’s—important decisions, debates, and discussion. If you’re giving a status update or just have a quick question, try to handle it asynchronously. Check out Meetings 101 to learn more.

Effective meetings have a clear goal, a short list of things to cover, and the right mix of attendees. If you decide to have a meeting, fill out the meeting prep worksheet below. When you’re done, double-check: Does everyone on the agenda really need to be there, or could they get the notes via email later?

In your invite, briefly summarize your points from the meeting prep worksheet above. If you’re working with people who like to prepare in advance, or if you’re trying to gather feedback asynchronously before the meeting, be sure to include reference docs with clear instructions. Is your invite too wordy? Try cutting it by half. Bonus points for including one of the 3d’s in your meeting title (ex: product design decision, team goals discussion, product roadmap debate).

Once the meeting is on the calendar, help get everyone—including yourself—ready. Your meeting will run more smoothly if the team is prepped and ready for the discussion. Read and share any relevant content beforehand so everyone has the same context. Make sure everyone has done their pre-meeting work. Send a friendly reminder if necessary. If you’d like anyone to share their screen, let them know ahead of time so they have the right documents handy. Think about the tone you’d like to set. For example, a team-building meeting should feel light and fun, whereas a check on well-being should feel safe and supportive.
translations: 在你本能地安排虚拟会议之前，请确保它是为了3D——重要决策、辩论和讨论。如果你是在做状态更新或只是有一个快速问题，尝试异步处理。查看《会议101》了解更多信息。
有效的会议有明确的目标、简短的待办事项清单以及合适的与会者组合。如果你决定召开会议，请填写下面的会议准备表。完成后，再次检查：议程上的每个人都真的需要参加吗，或者他们之后可以通过邮件获取会议记录？
在你的邀请中，简要总结你来自上述会议准备表的要点。如果你与喜欢提前准备的人合作，或者你想在会议前异步收集反馈，请务必包含带有清晰说明的参考文档。你的邀请是否过于冗长？尝试将其精简一半。在会议标题中包含3D之一可获得额外加分（例如：产品设计决策、团队目标讨论、产品路线图辩论）。
一旦会议被安排在日程上，帮助让每个人——包括你自己——做好准备。如果团队成员已准备好并进行讨论，你的会议将进行得更顺利。提前阅读和分享任何相关内容，以便大家有相同的背景信息。确保每个人都完成了会前工作。如有必要，发送友好的提醒。如果你希望任何人共享屏幕，请提前告知他们，以便他们手头有正确的文档。思考你想要设定的基调。例如，团队建设会议应该感觉轻松有趣，而健康检查会议应该感觉安全和支持。
fullTextParagraphs: Before you reflexively schedule a virtual meeting, make sure it’s for the 3d’s—important decisions, debates, and discussion. If you’re giving a status update or just have a quick question, try to handle it asynchronously. Check out Meetings 101 to learn more.

Effective meetings have a clear goal, a short list of things to cover, and the right mix of attendees. If you decide to have a meeting, fill out the meeting prep worksheet below. When you’re done, double-check: Does everyone on the agenda really need to be there, or could they get the notes via email later?

In your invite, briefly summarize your points from the meeting prep worksheet above. If you’re working with people who like to prepare in advance, or if you’re trying to gather feedback asynchronously before the meeting, be sure to include reference docs with clear instructions. Is your invite too wordy? Try cutting it by half. Bonus points for including one of the 3d’s in your meeting title (ex: product design decision, team goals discussion, product roadmap debate).

Once the meeting is on the calendar, help get everyone—including yourself—ready. Your meeting will run more smoothly if the team is prepped and ready for the discussion. Read and share any relevant content beforehand so everyone has the same context. Make sure everyone has done their pre-meeting work. Send a friendly reminder if necessary. If you’d like anyone to share their screen, let them know ahead of time so they have the right documents handy. Think about the tone you’d like to set. For example, a team-building meeting should feel light and fun, whereas a check on well-being should feel safe and supportive.

If you called the meeting, take advice from The Art of Gathering author Priya Parker and act as a gracious, authoritative host—someone who’s welcoming and warm yet confidently in charge. When your meeting starts: Leave time for unscripted chitchat. If your team members are remote, chances are they miss making impromptu connections. Warmly welcome everyone by their first name. If people don’t know each other, ask them to introduce themselves. Awkward silence? Try a creative conversation starter. Briefly restate your goal and agenda, and what happened the last time you met.If needed, give people a short “study hall” at the beginning to review reference docs. Encourage honesty and candor by creating a safe and confidential place for people to feel comfortable sharing their thoughts and ideas.

When we’re videoconferencing, it’s easy to space out or interrupt while someone else is talking. No matter your role, you can help ensure that all voices—not just the loudest—are heard in your meeting. Try to: Explicitly say you’d like to hear everyone’s perspective. Redirect when things go off topic: “JD, I love those ideas but I want to make sure we get through our agenda. Let’s put them in the parking lot.”Interrupt the interrupters: “Thanks, Justin, but I’d like to finish hearing from Eunice. Eunice, can you say more?”Call on quieter people: “I’d love to hear from folks who haven’t spoken yet. Monique, what do you think?”

When the meeting’s over, thank everyone for their time. Then quickly summarize the decision you made, what happens next, and who will do what. Have a notetaker prep a short recap and send it after. Bonus points for ending five minutes early, so people have more time to recharge. More resources

notes.meaning: 习惯性地安排虚拟会议
notes.explain: 指不假思索地、自动地安排线上会议，提醒人们在安排会议前先思考必要性
notes.example: Don't reflexively schedule a meeting for every small issue; consider if an email would suffice.

notes.phrase: fill out the meeting prep worksheet
notes.explain: 指在会议前填写准备表格，明确会议目标和议程，确保会议高效
notes.example: Before our quarterly review, please fill out the meeting prep worksheet with your department's key achievements.

notes.phrase: include reference docs with clear instructions
notes.meaning: 包含带有清晰说明的参考文档
notes.explain: 指在会议邀请中附上相关参考资料，并给出明确的指导，帮助与会者提前准备
notes.example: For the design review meeting, include reference docs with clear instructions on what feedback you need from each team member.

notes.meaning: 让每个人——包括你自己——做好准备
notes.explain: 强调会议组织者也需要像其他与会者一样做好充分准备，不能只关注他人
notes.example: To ensure a productive brainstorming session, get everyone—including yourself—ready by reviewing the creative brief beforehand.

scenario.title: Making Remote Meetings Productive
english: Sarah, a project manager, needs to coordinate with her team across three time zones to finalize the quarterly marketing campaign.
Her team members are frustrated with back-to-back virtual meetings that run over time and lack clear agendas, causing delays in their actual work.
Sarah implements a structured approach by sending pre-meeting materials with specific discussion points and time limits, resulting in a focused 30-minute session that achieves all objectives.
chinese: Sarah，一位项目经理，需要与跨越三个时区的团队合作，敲定季度营销活动方案。
她的团队成员对连续不断的远程会议感到沮丧，这些会议经常超时且缺乏明确议程，导致实际工作延误。
Sarah通过发送包含具体讨论点和时间限制的会前材料，实施了一种结构化方法，最终在30分钟的专注会议中达成了所有目标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 你需要安排一次远程会议，决定是否更换客户支持工具。请用英文写出会议目标，说明会前要准备的关键问题，邀请必要的决策者，并约定会议结束时记录负责人和下一步。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we meet to decide whether to replace the support tool? I’ll share the key questions in the invite and include only the people who need to advise on or make the decision. Let’s end with an owner and next step.
firstAttempt.rationale: 让会议有明确目标、合适参与者，并以负责人和行动收尾。

words.meaning: 反射地；本能地；不假思索地
words.example: Don't reflexively agree to every request without considering your priorities.
words.translation: 不要不假思索地同意每项请求而不考虑你的优先事项。
words.note: 表示不经过思考的、自动的反应，常用于提醒人们避免习惯性的、未经思考的行为。

words.example: Our team handles most communications asynchronously to respect everyone's focus time.
words.translation: 我们团队以异步方式处理大多数沟通，以尊重每个人的专注时间。
words.note: 指不要求同时参与的工作方式，与同步(synchronously)相对，在远程工作中常见。

words.example: I need to finish the prep for tomorrow's client presentation tonight.
words.translation: 我今晚需要完成明天客户演示的准备工作。
words.note: preparation的缩写，在职场中常用，表示为某事做的准备工作。

words.example: The report was too wordy, so I condensed it to just three pages.
words.translation: 这份报告太冗长了，所以我将其压缩到仅三页。
words.note: 形容表达过于冗长，缺乏简洁性，在职场沟通中应避免。

words.example: Please complete the pre-meeting reading materials before our strategy session.
words.translation: 请在我们的战略会议前完成会前阅读材料。
words.note: 表示在会议前进行的准备工作或活动，确保会议高效进行。

words.example: The company offers regular well-being checks to support employee mental health.
words.translation: 公司定期提供健康检查以支持员工心理健康。
words.note: 指身体、心理和情感的整体健康状态，在现代职场中越来越受重视。

structure.original: Before you reflexively schedule a virtual meeting, make sure it’s for the 3d’s—important decisions, debates, and discussion.
analysis: Before you reflexively schedule a virtual meeting 是时间状语从句，其中 reflexively 是副词修饰 schedule，表示'不假思索地'，整个从句表示'在你不假思索地安排虚拟会议之前'
make sure it's for the 3d's 是主句，其中 make sure 是'确保'的意思，it's for 表示'是为了...的目的'，破折号后的内容是对 3d's 的解释说明
important decisions, debates, and discussion 是三个并列名词短语，由逗号和 and 连接，共同构成 3d's 的具体内容，表示'重要决定、辩论和讨论'
structure.transfer: Before you automatically approve the budget proposal, make sure it's aligned with the 3c's—company goals, client needs, and compliance requirements.

rewrite.bad: Let’s invite the whole department and work out the meeting goal once everyone is there.
rewrite.good: Could we meet to decide which option to test next? I’ll add the goal and key questions to the invite and include only the people needed for the discussion.
rewrite.translation: 我们能否开会决定下一步测试哪个方案？我会在邀请中写清目标和关键问题，并只邀请需要参与讨论的人。
rewrite.pattern: Could we meet to [make a decision]? I’ll include [the goal, key questions, and required participants].

cloze.prompt: Share the ___ before the meeting so people can prepare.
cloze.why: 会前目标让参会者知道需要准备什么。

cloze.prompt: Invite the people who need to ___, rather than the whole team.
cloze.why: 参会者应与会议要完成的决策有关。

cloze.prompt: End with owners and next ___ so the work can move forward.
cloze.why: 负责人和后续动作使会议结论可执行。

translationPractice.prompt: 请在会前说明目标，让大家有所准备。
translationPractice.answer: Please share the goal before the meeting so people can prepare.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“Share the goal before the meeting.”在会前说明会议要解决什么时的用法。

translationPractice.prompt: 邀请需要参与决策的人，而不是整个团队。
translationPractice.answer: Invite the people who need to decide, rather than the whole team.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“Invite the people who need to decide.”在邀请能提供意见或作决定的人时的用法。

choice.prompt: 你准备为一个需要讨论方案的议题约远程会议。请用英文说明会议目标，并建议只邀请需要参与讨论或决策的人。
options: I need the market analysis report by Friday for our meeting. Make sure it's comprehensive.
Could we meet to decide which option to test next? I’ll add the goal and key questions to the invite, and include only the people needed for the discussion.
Could we meet to decide which option to test next?
choice.why: 会议应服务于重要决定、讨论或辩论，并有清晰目标和合适的参会者。

output.prompt: 你要组织一次会议，决定是否延长新客户试用期。请用英文写出会议目标、会前需要查看的数据、需要参加的决策人，以及结束时要记录的内容。
output.sample: The goal is to decide whether to extend the trial period for new customers. Please review the activation and support data before the meeting. I’ll invite the product and customer success leads, and we’ll finish by recording the decision, owner, and next step.
check: 是否在会前写明明确目标？
是否邀请真正需要提供意见或决策的人？
是否安排会议结束时确定负责人和下一步？
